sentences.text:
Order 
This is an admitted appeal.

2. This appeal has been filed by the appellant - claimant under Section 173 (1) of the Motor Vehicle Act, 1988 for enhancement of compensation of Rs.2,00,000/- against the award dated 18.2.2021 passed in M.A.C.T. No.40 of 2018 by Additional Member, M.A.C.T., Pawai, district Panna, M.P.
3.

The case of the appellant - claimant is that on 29.5.2017 he met with an accident with the offending vehicle and sustained fracture of tibia fabula of left let and sustained 30% disability which is referred in Para-11 of the award but learned tribunal has not considered the certificate Ex.P-7 on the ground that it is mentioned in the certificate "this is not valid for court proceeding".
4.
Learned counsel for the respondents supports the impugned award.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
6. This court is of the view that there is possibility of little enhancement.
In view of the note in the certificate, Ex.P-7, is discarded for enhancement of compensation.

Therefore, on the lump sum basis under the aforesaid heads, Rs.46,000/- is awarded by this court.
8. Rate of interest and conditions shall remain the same as already held by learned tribunal.
